note: The page prints the communion without the Low Sunday Alleluias, which the digital witness declares as Paschaltide recensions; the punctuation differences are recorded below.

adjudicated.ruling: The digital Low Sunday text sets a comma before its Alleluia; the typical edition prints clavórum: for 21 December (p. 441).
The digital Low Sunday text continues with its Alleluias; the typical edition ends the communion with fidélis. (p. 441).
